_comment: Head-to-head cost for one 1280x704 x 97-frame (4.04s @24fps) i2v clip on the RTX 5090, same keyframe and same prompt. Measured 2026-08-05 by submitting each workflow directly and sampling nvidia-smi every 2s. Both runs completed with status success; the ComfyUI log contains no out-of-memory events (the only 'oom' matches in it are the words 'room' and 'broom').
_vram_note: peak_vram_mib is whole-GPU used, not the model footprint. ComfyUI expands to fill available VRAM, so both engines peak near the 32607 MiB ceiling and the two numbers are NOT a ranking. The load-bearing fact is that HunyuanVideo 1.5 fp16 (16.6 GB UNET + 9.4 GB Qwen2.5-VL text encoder + 2.5 GB VAE) FITS on a 32 GB card at 1280x704x97 and completes without OOM or offload failure.

hunyuan._cfg_note: cfg 6.0 means a live negative branch and TWO model evaluations per step, so 20 steps costs 40 forward passes against LTX's 8.

_batch_note: render_secs.json records 1584.7s for the first card of the batch (head_turn) against ~810s for each of the five that followed. The difference is model load; a warm queue costs ~810s per clip. The 820.2s measured here is a cold-ish load after LTX had evicted Hunyuan, and it lands on the warm number, so load is amortised inside the sample rather than added to it.
